$comment: The CMS is this file. See README.md — adding a product is one entry in `items`. `shape` also fixes the canonical orientation (the engine never rotates); `skin.light`/`skin.dark` are root-relative PNGs under /skins/ laid across the whole piece, and an empty string falls back to the accent-fill placeholder; `eye` and `iconAt` are [cx, cy] cells of that shape, optionally [cx, cy, ax, ay] to nudge inside the cell — keep both clear of the sticker band; `bandName` overrides the name shown on the sticker when the full name will not fit the shape's band; `motion` names a personality preset from src/lib/content.ts.
